headline: Public hearings on parking requests and a four-way stop, plus $7,861,647 and $9,099,330 school roof bonds.
summary: The agenda lists public hearings on resident, handicapped, and child care parking requests, plus a surveillance technology ordinance and a four-way stop. It also includes school roof bond requests, a proposed zoning amendment, and a resolution of no confidence in the mayor.
